products.meta.title: PROFROBOT products: platform, RaaS, Retrofit
products.meta.description: Robot fleet management platform, robot rental (RaaS), retrofit of your equipment, AI modules and Open API integration. PROFROBOT products.
products.hero.title: PROFROBOT products and business models.
products.hero.lead: Buying a robot is only half the job. Next you have to manage it, service it and know whether it pays back.
products.hero.text: Our products cover exactly that: a platform to control your fleet, rental instead of buying, retrofit of equipment you already own, and integration with your systems.
products.catalog.label: Page contents: seven products
products.platform.title: The platform your whole fleet runs on.
products.platform.lead: PROFROBOT Platform is our own development. It manages robots of any type and manufacturer, from cleaners to humanoids, and we write the features you are missing for your task.
products.platform.trust.data: Data in Russia, data center in Skolkovo
products.platform.board.label: Sample platform dashboard: 142 devices, 14 sites, 98.2% SLA, 24 active operations
products.platform.board.foot: Cleaning · delivery · warehouse · humanoids on one map
products.platform.fleet.text: A fleet across several sites from one center: grouping by site and status, bulk commands, remote setup and updates.
products.platform.dispatch.text: Operations control and task allocation across devices: a map, statuses and errors in real time, failure alerts.
products.platform.ai.text: Recognition, workflows and operating analytics on top of the base hardware. Our in-house AI agents predict failures before downtime.
products.platform.api.text: Integration with the client’s ERP, BMS and accounting systems. The platform fits into your infrastructure rather than replacing it.
products.raas.title: Rental instead of buying. Start without big upfront costs.
products.raas.lead: Robot rental (RaaS, Robots-as-a-Service) removes the large one-off payment: a lower entry cost, a faster start, pay for use.
products.raas.points.entry.title: Lower entry cost
products.raas.points.entry.text: A regular payment instead of a big purchase. No need to secure an equipment budget in advance.
products.raas.points.start.title: Faster start
products.raas.points.start.text: You test the robot at your own site and decide on buying from real numbers.
products.raas.points.use.title: Pay for use
products.raas.points.use.text: Take one for high season or a pilot and return it when utilization drops. We choose equipment from several brands.
products.raas.calc.title: Buy or rent: an example
products.raas.calc.chartLabel: Cumulative cost chart: buying and renting
products.raas.calc.note: An illustration based on market benchmarks, not a PROFROBOT price list. Buying includes ownership costs (service, consumables, operator time) at 16% of the price per year. We assume rental includes maintenance. We calculate the rate and term for your site.
products.retrofit.title: Retrofit: equipment you already bought keeps working.
products.retrofit.lead: We upgrade existing equipment: adding cameras, navigation, sensors and semi-automatic workflows. It’s often faster and cheaper than buying a new robot.
products.retrofit.cmp.label: Diagram: what you pay for with a new robot versus a retrofit
products.retrofit.cmp.newNote: you pay for the machine and autonomy
products.retrofit.cmp.caption: Cost structure, not to scale. At the assessment we work out which is cheaper for your site: upgrade or replacement.
products.retrofit.add.title: What we add to equipment
products.why.title: How our products differ from a catalog.
products.why.platform.title: Our own platform
products.why.platform.text: This is not a vendor license but PROFROBOT’s own Russian development. We connect robots of any brand and write what’s missing. Data stored in Russia, data center in Skolkovo.
products.why.ai.title: AI agents built in-house
products.why.ai.text: They predict failures before downtime and reroute cleaning in real time.
products.why.service.title: Service across Russia
products.why.service.text: Our own service network, working under SLA. The platform spots a failure, service fixes it.
products.why.makers.title: Any manufacturer
products.why.makers.text: 2–5 vendors per area: we take what fits the task and the economics, not what we hold exclusive rights to.
products.why.roi.title: Economics first
products.why.roi.text: The conversation starts with your site’s payback.

products.talk.title: Want to start without a big investment?
products.talk.lead: Leave your details. We’ll call, ask a few questions and suggest what fits: rental, the platform for your fleet or an equipment upgrade.
